stories.title: Nakashima Stuns Medvedev in Three-Set Cincinnati Thriller

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Down 0-40 facing three match points at 4-5 in the second set — Nakashima saved them all, then bageled Medvedev in the third. 6-7, 7-6, 6-1 in Cincinnati. What a run this summer. #Tennis #Cincinnati #Nakashima #ATP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Nakashima: Montreal runner-up. Cincinnati R16. Career-high No. 22. Three match points saved vs. Medvedev. He's having the summer of his career and we are here for it. #Tennis #Nakashima #Cincinnati #USOpen
